scenarios.title: A｜房型不符
scenarios.setting: 在“入住时房间不符合预订”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“房型不符”。

turns.text: Good evening. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「入住时房间不符合预订」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I think there’s a problem with my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think there’s a problem with my room.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Hi, I just checked in, but I think I’ve been given the wrong room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I just checked in, but I think I’ve been given the wrong room.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: Excuse me, my room doesn’t match my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, my room doesn’t match my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Hi, my room has a problem.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think there’s a problem with my room.
feedback.explanation: 这句语法可以理解；指出具体问题比只说“房间有问题”更利于处理，也可以先用它引出后面的说明。

choices.text: My room is not same with my booking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think there’s a problem with my room.
feedback.explanation: 比较两个事物是否相同时，常用“the same as”；不要直接照中文说成“same with / like”。

turns.text: I’m sorry to hear that. What’s the problem?

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: I booked a deluxe room, but I’ve been given a standard room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I booked a deluxe room, but I’ve been given a standard room.
feedback.explanation: “deluxe room”指豪华房，通常是酒店的房型名称，具体配置还需核对。

choices.text: My reservation is for a deluxe room, but this is a standard room.

feedback.naturalExpression: My reservation is for a deluxe room, but this is a standard room.
feedback.explanation: “deluxe room”指豪华房，通常是酒店的房型名称，具体配置还需核对。

choices.text: I think I’ve been given the wrong room type.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’ve been given the wrong room type.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: I booked deluxe room, but you give me standard room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I booked a deluxe room, but I’ve been given a standard room.
feedback.explanation: 单数房型前需要“a”；对已经分配的房间，可用“I’ve been given …”说明当前结果。

turns.text: I apologize. Let me check your reservation… Yes, you’re right. You booked a deluxe room.

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否换一个更合适的位置或房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you change me to the room type I booked?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you change me to the room type I booked?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there a deluxe room available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a deluxe room available?
feedback.explanation: “deluxe room”指豪华房，通常是酒店的房型名称，具体配置还需核对。

choices.text: Could I get the room I originally booked?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I get the room I originally booked?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Can you change my room to a deluxe room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you change my room to a deluxe room?
feedback.explanation: “deluxe room”指豪华房，通常是酒店的房型名称，具体配置还需核对。

choices.text: Can you give my correct room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you change me to the room type I booked?
feedback.explanation: “give”后要有人和物两个对象，如“give me …”；这里说“the room type I booked”能明确要求按原预订安排。

turns.text: Let me check… Yes, we have a deluxe room available on the tenth floor.

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否换一个更合适的位置或房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Can I move to that room now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Can I move to that room now?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: That would be great. Could you change my room, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: That would be great. Could you change my room, please?
feedback.explanation: “would be great”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll take that room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll take that room.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay, I want change there now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Can I move to that room now?
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: Of course. I’ll prepare a new key card for you. I apologize for the mistake.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No problem. Thank you for sorting it out.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Thank you for sorting it out.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: That’s okay. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: B｜床型不符
scenarios.setting: 在“入住时房间不符合预订”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“床型不符”。

turns.prompt: 关于「入住时房间不符合预订」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, I think there’s a problem with the bed in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think there’s a problem with the bed in my room.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Hi, I think I was given the wrong bed type.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think I was given the wrong bed type.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Excuse me, the bed isn’t what I booked.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, the bed isn’t what I booked.
feedback.explanation: “I booked”交代原先的预订，适合核对实际安排是否一致。

choices.text: My bed type has a mistake.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think there’s a problem with the bed in my room.
feedback.explanation: 床型不是会犯错的人；可以说“the bed type is wrong”或说明与预订不一致。

turns.text: I’m sorry about that. What kind of bed did you book?

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: I booked a room with one king-size bed, but this room has two single beds.

feedback.naturalExpression: I booked a room with one king-size bed, but this room has two single beds.
feedback.explanation: “king-size bed”指特大双人床，指床的规格。

choices.text: My reservation says one king-size bed, but there are two single beds in the room.

feedback.naturalExpression: My reservation says one king-size bed, but there are two single beds in the room.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: I requested a king-size bed, not two single beds.

feedback.naturalExpression: I requested a king-size bed, not two single beds.
feedback.explanation: “king-size bed”指特大双人床，指床的规格。

choices.text: I booked one big bed, but there are two small beds.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I booked a room with one king-size bed, but this room has two single beds.
feedback.explanation: 这句能理解；“king-size bed / single beds”用明确床型名称，比“大床、小床”更便于对照预订。

choices.text: I booked a king bed, but the room have two beds.

feedback.naturalExpression: I booked a room with one king-size bed, but this room has two single beds.
feedback.explanation: “the room”是单数，搭配“has”；明确“king-size / single”也能避免只比较床的大小。

turns.text: Let me check your reservation… Yes, I can see that you requested a king-size bed.

turns.prompt: 你想确认是否有合适的款式或尺寸，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you have a room with a king-size bed available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a room with a king-size bed available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Would it be possible to switch to a room with a king-size bed?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to switch to a room with a king-size bed?
feedback.explanation: “king-size bed”指特大双人床，指床的规格。

choices.text: Could you move me to the room I booked?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you move me to the room I booked?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Can I change a king-size bed room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a room with a king-size bed available?
feedback.explanation: 可说“change to a room with a king-size bed”；原句“change a … room”没有说清是换入还是改动房间。

turns.text: Yes. We have one available on the seventh floor.

turns.prompt: 关于「入住时房间不符合预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Great. I’d like to switch rooms, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’d like to switch rooms, please.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Perfect. Could I move to that room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Could I move to that room?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Yes, that would be much better. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that would be much better. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Okay, please change another room for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’d like to switch rooms, please.
feedback.explanation: 换到另一间房通常说“move me to another room / switch rooms”，不直接说“change another room for me”。

turns.text: Certainly. I’ll make you a new key card.

turns.prompt: 你想确认换房后旧房卡如何处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do I need to bring the old key card back?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to bring the old key card back?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Should I return my current key card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I return my current key card?
feedback.explanation: “key card”指房卡，即开门用的卡片。

choices.text: What should I do with the old key card?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I do with the old key card?
feedback.explanation: “key card”指房卡，即开门用的卡片。

choices.text: Do you need my old card back?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to bring the old key card back?
feedback.explanation: 这句可以自然询问是否需要收回旧卡；“old key card”比“old card”更明确，但语境清楚时可省略。

turns.text: Yes, please bring it back when you come downstairs.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. Thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: No problem. Thanks for sorting this out.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Thanks for sorting this out.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: C｜被安排到吸烟房
scenarios.setting: 在“入住时房间不符合预订”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“被安排到吸烟房”。

turns.prompt: 你想说明分到的房间与需求不符，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, I think I’ve been given a smoking room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think I’ve been given a smoking room.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: Hi, there’s a strong smell of smoke in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, there’s a strong smell of smoke in my room.
feedback.explanation: “smell of smoke”明确是烟味，比泛泛说气味不好更便于处理。

choices.text: I think my room is a smoking room, but I booked a non-smoking room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think my room is a smoking room, but I booked a non-smoking room.

choices.text: My room has too much smoking smell.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think I’ve been given a smoking room.
feedback.explanation: “smoking smell”不常这样搭配，通常说“smell of smoke”；若重点是被分到吸烟房，应明确房间类型。

turns.text: I’m sorry about that. Let me check your reservation.

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: My reservation should be for a non-smoking room.

feedback.naturalExpression: My reservation should be for a non-smoking room.
feedback.explanation: “non-smoking room”是不吸烟客房；提到原预订的房型，便于工作人员核对安排。

choices.text: I specifically booked a non-smoking room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I specifically booked a non-smoking room.
feedback.explanation: “non-smoking room”是不吸烟客房；提到原预订的房型，便于工作人员核对安排。

choices.text: Could you check whether my booking says non-smoking?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check whether my booking says non-smoking?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: I remember I choose non-smoking room.

feedback.naturalExpression: My reservation should be for a non-smoking room.
feedback.explanation: 回忆已经选择过的房型要用过去式“chose”，且“a non-smoking room”需要冠词。

turns.text: You’re right. Your reservation does say non-smoking. I apologize for the mistake.

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否换一个更合适的位置或房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you move me to a non-smoking room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you move me to a non-smoking room?
feedback.explanation: “non-smoking room”是不吸烟客房；提到原预订的房型，便于工作人员核对安排。

choices.text: Do you have another non-smoking room available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have another non-smoking room available?
feedback.explanation: “non-smoking room”是不吸烟客房；提到原预订的房型，便于工作人员核对安排。

choices.text: I’d like to change rooms, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change rooms, if possible.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Can you give me a room without smoke?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could you move me to a non-smoking room?
feedback.explanation: 这句能表达无烟需求；“non-smoking room”是酒店的标准房型说法，不只是暂时没有烟味。

choices.text: Can you change me a no-smoking room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you move me to a non-smoking room?
feedback.explanation: “change me a room”搭配不自然；可说“move me to a non-smoking room”。

turns.text: Let me check… We have a non-smoking room available on the sixth floor.

turns.prompt: 你想确认替代房间是否与原预订的房型一致，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is it the same room type as the one I booked?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it the same room type as the one I booked?
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

choices.text: Is it also a deluxe room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it also a deluxe room?
feedback.explanation: “deluxe room”指豪华房，通常是酒店的房型名称，具体配置还需核对。

choices.text: Will the room be the same size?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will the room be the same size?
feedback.explanation: “same size”确认大小或标准是否相同，适合在更换方案时核对条件。

choices.text: Is that room same with my booking?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it the same room type as the one I booked?
feedback.explanation: 比较两个事物是否相同时，常用“the same as”；不要直接照中文说成“same with / like”。

turns.text: Yes. It’s the same room type, just on a different floor.

turns.prompt: 关于「入住时房间不符合预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: That’s fine. I’d like to switch to that room, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’d like to switch to that room, please.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Perfect. That works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. That works for me.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Great. Could you change my room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could you change my room?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Of course. I’ll give you a new key card right away.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I appreciate your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I appreciate your help.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Great, thanks for taking care of it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks for taking care of it.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thank you very much.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you very much.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: D｜酒店提出其他房间

turns.text: I’m very sorry, but we don’t have any more rooms of the type you originally booked tonight.

turns.prompt: 你想了解酒店还能提供哪些替代房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: What other rooms do you have available?

feedback.naturalExpression: What other rooms do you have available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Is there another room you can offer me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there another room you can offer me?

choices.text: What are my options?

choices.text: Is there an additional charge?

feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Would the price be the same as my original booking?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would the price be the same as my original booking?

choices.text: Do I need to pay more for the upgrade?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to pay more for the upgrade?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Do I need pay more money?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would I have to pay extra for that room?
feedback.explanation: “need”后接动作时通常用“need to + 动词原形”。补上“to”，才能把“需要”和具体动作连接起来。

turns.text: No. Since this was our mistake, we’ll upgrade you at no additional charge.

turns.prompt: 关于「入住时房间不符合预订」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds good. I’ll take the upgrade.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. I’ll take the upgrade.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: In that case, the larger room works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, the larger room works for me.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: Okay, I’d be happy to take that room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’d be happy to take that room.
feedback.explanation: “I’d be happy to”表示乐意这样做，传达积极配合的态度。

choices.text: That’s fine. I’ll take it.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’ll take it.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.text: Certainly. The new room is on the ninth floor.

turns.prompt: 你想核实换房后原有服务是否仍然包含，会怎么说？

choices.text: Does the new room still have all the same amenities?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does the new room still have all the same amenities?
feedback.explanation: “amenities”指配套设施或用品，可用于确认房间更换后包含哪些服务。

choices.text: Is breakfast still included with the new room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is breakfast still included with the new room?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Will everything else in my reservation stay the same?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will everything else in my reservation stay the same?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: My other booking things won’t change, right?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Does the new room still have all the same amenities?
feedback.explanation: “booking things”太笼统；应说清关心的是房型、早餐还是其他设施，便于前台逐项确认。

turns.text: Yes. Everything else in your reservation will remain the same.

turns.prompt: 你想确认接受新房间并完成换房安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Could I have the new key card, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could I have the new key card, please?
feedback.explanation: “key card”指房卡，即开门用的卡片。

choices.text: Perfect. I’m happy with that. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’m happy with that. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “I'm happy”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Great, thanks for finding another room for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks for finding another room for me.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

turns.text: Of course. Here’s your new key card. Again, we apologize for the inconvenience.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No problem. Thank you for resolving it.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Thank you for resolving it.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: That’s all right. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s all right. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thank you. I appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。
